name: listRest
description: Gets a list, without its first element.
syntax: listRest( string list, [string delimiters], [boolean includeEmptyFields], [number offset] )

params.name: delimiters
params.description: Characters that separate list elements. The default value is comma.

params.name: includeEmptyFields
params.description: if set to true, empty values are included as well

params.name: offset
params.description: specifies how many items to skip from the beginning of the list. default is 1.
